notes: Ensure that the README does not include any proprietary or sensitive information. Focus on clarity and completeness in each section.

steps.details: Create a new README.md file in the root directory of the repository. This file will contain sections for system architecture, workflow, and usage instructions.

Add a section titled 'System Architecture' in the README.md. Provide a high-level overview of the system's components and their interactions. Use diagrams if necessary, but ensure they are described in text for accessibility.

Add a section titled 'Workflow' in the README.md. Describe the typical flow of operations within the system, including key processes and data flow. Ensure the description is clear and logically ordered.

Add a section titled 'Usage Instructions' in the README.md. Provide step-by-step instructions on how to set up and use the system. Include any prerequisites, installation steps, and example commands. Ensure the instructions are easy to follow.

Review the README.md to ensure it is correctly formatted in Markdown. Use headings, lists, and code blocks where appropriate to enhance readability. Verify that all sections are clearly delineated and that the document meets Markdown standards.
